observations: Single 2:1 warm library panorama with three separate living cats, carved shelves, rugs, plants, stained glass, tea set and brass lamp.
Cats appear anatomically coherent at native viewing size; the small cat forms under the table are decorative figurines.
No readable book titles, logo, watermark, external border, grid or jigsaw seams observed.
minorDeviations: The added clock at upper left has small dial numerals, so the strict no-text request is not fully satisfied.
Some decorative book-spine marks resemble tiny glyphs, although no coherent book title is readable.
The nearest foreground cushion and rug edge are slightly softer than the central room.
